name: skeuomorphism-ui
description: Skeuomorphic restyling — the soft-and-physical language in which the surface IMITATES A NAMED MATERIAL. Emits a material token layer built on one overhead light source, rewrites components to the four-layer shadow stack plus a three-stop face gradient, a hairline material border and letterpress type, puts a single inline-SVG grain layer on the chassis rather than on every component, inverts the stack for recessed wells, and self-audits every emitted pair against WCAG 2.2. A soft surface imitating nothing is neumorphism-ui (same colour as the page ground) or claymorphism-ui (inflated pastel).
